cards.card_text: The king stops at the last house while all his servants march past him: the Cherethites and Pelethites, men under David's command, plus six hundred Gittites who followed him from Gath.
cards.verse_text: He stopped at the last house, and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.
cards.snippet: …last house, and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.

cards.card_text: Out of Jerusalem they march: Joab's men, the Cherethites, the Pelethites and ALL the mighty men.
cards.verse_text: So Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.

cards.card_text: So Zadok, Nathan and Benaiah, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, set Solomon on King David's mule.
cards.verse_text: Then Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
